query: SELECT id AS "id!: ContactId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(status = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (id > $4) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(status = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND ($4 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) __ids ORDER BY id ASC
